A desk-worker timer that nudges you to stand, stretch and fix your posture on a schedule you set.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose how often you want a posture break.
  2. Press Start and keep working — the countdown runs in the tab.
  3. When it fires, stand, stretch and reset your posture; breaks are counted for today.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How often should I take a posture break?

Every 30 minutes is the common recommendation: stand, roll your shoulders, and look away from the screen for a minute.

What should I do during the break?

Stand up, stretch your chest and hip flexors, roll your neck gently, and reset your sitting posture when you sit back down.

Does the counter reset daily?

Yes — it tracks breaks per calendar day in this browser.
